radial_12_10.name: Radial 12/10 — small FSCW PMSM
radial_12_10.source: Sato, Miki, Nakamura, Machines 2023, 11, 824, Table 1 CONV. Slot/pole combination is the textbook FSCW example (kw=0.933, Cros & Viarouge 2002). Magnetic-circuit formulae: Pyrhönen, Jokinen, Hrabovcová, Design of Rotating Electrical Machines, ch. 3–6. ke/kt: Hendershot & Miller / Hanselman.

scaling.rule: After a diameter change, airgap, magnet thickness and yoke height keep the ratios of this preset until the field is overwritten. Ratios follow Pyrhönen ch. 6 typical PM proportions (g/D, lm/g, hy/τp).

axial_torus_18_6.name: Axial TORUS 18/6 — 10 kW class
axial_torus_18_6.source: Mahmoudi, Kahourzade, Rahim, Hew, Progress In Electromagnetics Research 129, 2012, Table 4 (10 kW EV TORUS). Sizing equations are those of Gieras, Wang, Kamper, Axial Flux Permanent Magnet Brushless Machines.

scaling.rule: Gieras typical inner/outer diameter ratio λ ≈ 0.58. Airgap and magnet thickness scale with outer diameter from this preset until overwritten.
